YOUR MANUAL COLLABORATION LOOP

One goal. A better next step.

1. Start with the same brief

Create a task, add the goal and facts, then use Copy brief. Paste it into your existing AI chats. Each AI gets the same starting point and your approved lessons.

2. Bring their answers back

Paste each response under its AI's name. Use Copy cross-review to take all the answers into another chat. Ask it to check claims, not just agree. Paste that review here as another response.

3. Make the call and test it

Record supported agreement, disagreements, your decision, and the outcome in Your call. You decide what to act on.

4. Improve the method

Propose a lesson with evidence and a test. Approve it when you want it included in future briefs. Record whether it helped. Lessons can be returned to proposed status without deleting them.

What this workspace does

It organizes your pasted work and builds prompts. It does not contact AI services, run background conversations, verify answers automatically, or train the models. Your existing chat services may have their own limits.

Keep a backup

Data is saved only in this browser. Export creates a JSON file you can import on another device. Import adds records; conflicting versions are kept as separate copies. Imported lessons require approval here before use. Backups contain your pasted text—share them only where you intend.
